summary: Kosmos Energy Ltd. filed an 8-K on June 22, 2026, reporting completion of the sale of its participating interests in the Ceiba Field and Okume Complex in Block G offshore Equatorial Guinea to a subsidiary of Panoro Energy ASA. Final cash consideration was approximately $127 million, plus up to $39.5 million in contingent payments tied to production and oil prices. The sale was governed by a February 24, 2026 Purchase Agreement. The board recommended and closed the transaction. Mechanics: asset sale with post-closing adjustments. What to watch: contingent consideration milestones and Panoro's integration of the assets.
